schema.name: nx_sim_constraints
schema.description: Inspect constraints in the active SIM and reacquire typed references after reopen. offset >=0; limit 1..100. Compact rows include type, target-set count and stored MCP provenance/basis when present. include_properties returns native values, units and explicit unsupported/read-failed fields. include_targets returns up to 100 members per set with truncation flags; SIM face members have typed refs, other kinds are marked unsupported. This covers the Constraints collection, not loads or simulation objects. Read-only: no activation, save, mutation or solve.

outputSchema.description: Structured success/error envelope with additive metadata. Tool-specific payload remains extensible.
outputSchema.title: nx_sim_constraints result
